purpose: Reference-driven Coot remake as an executable technical example, not a fixed template for every product
required_assets: assets/proof/0001.jpg..0112.jpg (if the proof scene is retained)

files.compose.py: Frame-addressable 2D+PBR plate compositor. Reads storyboard.json for actual boundaries. Adapt copy, shot graph and motion to new product.
files.render_3d.py: Phone/brand-disc/stack geometry, PBR and true per-frame transform animation; accepts phone|coin|stack --eevee or --cycles.
files.score.py: Legacy 128BPM diagnostic only: explicit --diagnostic required. Never default production music.
files.example-shot-map.json: Copy to storyboard.json next to scripts after adaptation.

execution: Prepare product textures/logo/font files; bind paths and actual copy.
Render required 3D plates: blender -b --python render_3d.py -- phone --eevee (also coin/stack if used).
python compose.py --preview; inspect full composition and continuous seams.
python compose.py --render --silent-preview for visual work, or --audio <reviewed mix.wav>; follow audio-contract.md for shared real events and final QA
limits: Not an automatic perfect replica of every reference. 3D geometry, original assets, material/light matching and sound need per-project work.
Rendered 3D plates, commercial source videos and product logos are not bundled in the reusable skill.
Never silently use the Coot sample copy or branding for a different product.
This historical compositor has fixed visual content. Adapt its actual renderer to consume project motion-events.json before production sound synchronization.
